intro.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Foshan Hongyun Jiangtian Packaging Materials Co., Ltd was established on 8 August 2008. We are a large plastic packaging enterprise integrating research, production and sales of container bags (FIBC bulk bags).

Our products are widely used for the outer packaging of goods in the chemical industry, mineral powders, rice, feed, compound fertilizer, cement and logistics, as well as for mattresses, sofas, fruit, vegetables and plastics.

The company has a strong manufacturing base: 5 own factories in different regions of China and 5 distribution warehouses in Guangxi, Hunan, Shaanxi and Hubei, enabling fast shipment. Modern workshops cover over 8,000 m², with annual output exceeding 10 million bags.

Our products meet SGS standards, and in 2005 we completed an order for the United States Postal Service for eco-friendly postal bags — international recognition of our quality. Products cover over 30 provinces in China and are exported to Japan, Europe, America, Africa and Southeast Asia.

We follow the principle of "quality first, honesty and trust". The company holds a continuous Class A tax credit rating and a foreign trade licence, allowing import and export across all commodity categories.

quality.title: Quality policy
paragraphs: We believe that for bulk packaging, safety and consistency matter more than price alone. A failed FIBC in transit means product loss, contamination and a damaged customer relationship.

Therefore every order follows a fixed quality workflow: raw material verification, in-line inspection during weaving and sewing, safety-factor load testing, and a final pre-shipment inspection with photo reports sent to the customer before container loading.

items.q: What is your minimum order quantity?
items.a: Our minimum order quantity depends on the bag type and customization. For standard FIBC bags, a smaller trial order can be arranged; for fully customized printing, a higher quantity is required for cost efficiency. Please contact us with your requirement.

items.q: Can you produce bags according to my drawing or sample?
items.a: Yes. We produce to your drawing, specification sheet or physical sample. We can also provide a pre-production sample for your confirmation before mass production.
For standard bags, production usually takes about 15–25 days after order confirmation. For customized and printed orders, lead time may be longer. Please confirm with us at the time of order.
Every order passes raw material verification, in-process inspection and a pre-shipment inspection with photo reports. Load testing verifies the safety factor 5:1 / 6:1.

items.q: Do you ship to the Middle East?
items.a: Yes. The Middle East is one of our main export markets. We arrange shipment to your designated port — Jebel Ali, Dammam, Alexandria, Umm Qasr and others — and we prepare the documentation required for customs clearance.

items.q: Do you accept OEM and custom printing?
items.a: Yes. We offer OEM production and multi-color printing of your logo, brand and technical marks on the bag.
